title: Herbaceous Norwegian Curry Paste Wrap
description: A light, umami-rich Norwegian dish featuring panang curry paste in a spherified ti-leaf wrap. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: ti-leaf wraps
ingredients.notes: available at Asian markets or online

instructions: Heat the panang curry paste in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the spherified tapioca pearls and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until they start to pop.
In a large bowl, whisk together the grated ginger, zesty lime juice, and kosher salt.
Add the sliced cucumber and red bell pepper to the bowl and toss to combine with the dressing.
Warm the ti-leaf wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the cucumber mixture onto the center of each wrap, followed by a few spherified tapioca pearls and a sprinkle of crumbled feta cheese.
Drizzle the panang curry paste mixture over the top of each wrap and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Repeat the process for the remaining wraps.
Optional: add a pinch of sugar to the panang curry paste mixture for a touch of sweetness.
Don't overcrowd the wraps, as this can cause the spherified tapioca pearls to become dislodged from the panang curry paste mixture.
